mapper.select: SELECT id AS "id", last_seen_at AS "lastSeenAt", alarm_code AS "alarmCode" FROM downtime WHERE equipment_id = #{equipmentId} ORDER BY last_seen_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE downtime SET last_seen_at = #{recordedAt}, duration_sec = duration_sec + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO downtime (equipment_id, work_order_id, started_at, last_seen_at, duration_sec, alarm_code, reason_code, reason_source) SELECT #{row.equipmentId}, #{row.workOrderId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{row.recordedAt}, #{row.recordedAt}, 1, #{row.alarmCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, a.reason_code, CASE WHEN a.reason_code IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 'AUTO' END FROM (SELECT 1) one LEFT JOIN equipment_alarm a ON a.alarm_code = #{row.alarmCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND a.equipment_id = #{row.equipmentId}
